correctness.rationale: With generator a(theta)*partial_z^2+q*partial_theta^2+r[f(0,theta)-f(z,theta)], a(theta)=barD+delta*cos(2(theta-phi)), stationarity and uniform angular invariant measure yield r E[z^2]=2barD and (r+4q)E[z^2 cos2(theta-phi)]=delta. The z^4 generator equation gives E[z^4]=24barD^2/r^2+12delta^2/[r(r+4q)]. Independently, the age T~Exp(r), angular covariance exp(-4q|t-s|)/2 and conditional Gaussian Wick fourth moment reproduce the same coefficient. Strict Dparallel,Dperp,q,r>0 ensures uniqueness, K=3 iff delta=0, and 3<K<6 otherwise, with sharp singular supremum 6. Symbolic generator and independent Laplace-age integrals passed, including the exact example variance=2, fourth=51/2, excess=27/8. No finite experiment replaces these all-parameter identities.

originality.rationale: The same mathematical model Chaki--Olsen--Löwen 2024/2025 paper establishes stationary covariance isotropy and asserts a stronger, full Laplace-equivalence conclusion. Inspecting its actual position-only resetting and discussion paragraphs shows its general renewal formula is prior but the fourth moment is not evaluated there; the present formula is a quantitative counterexample to the asserted distributional equivalence and identifies the exact contrast bound. An isotropic classical reset formula covers only the delta=0 boundary. Resultary and related active resetting source checks found no covering evaluated formula. A later full-text or general Markov-additive fourth-moment treatment could subsume the expression; this is a best-of-knowledge assessment, not a novelty certificate.

value.rationale: The baseline 2024 work explicitly identifies position-only reset as restoring a spherical-particle stationary law; the new strictly positive fourth cumulant furnishes a parameter-uniform counterexample, a sharp 3<K<6 range and a feasible stationary signature of microscopic anisotropy despite a rotationally invariant position distribution. This is a substantive correction to a same mathematical model physical inference, not a routine covariance calculation.

limitations: All diffusivities and angular/reset rates strictly positive; no q=0 nonunique angular invariant boundary, active propulsion or drift.
All stationary scalar projections are isotropic but not Laplace when Dparallel!=Dperp; the sign of diffusivity contrast cannot be recovered.
No finite-time density formula or statistical sampling guarantee is proved.
